sources.title: UAE Information Assurance Regulation v1.1
sources.locator: Sections 1.1 and 2.1; control tables, Always applicable controls

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.

Official full text is available, but this research does not prove that the March 2020 text is the complete currently applicable national or emirate baseline in October 2026. Priority P1–P4 is not a national maturity grade.
